title: agent-teams Pi writer contract
description: Extension of the spawn contract for writing branches. The Writer Barrier stays closed until every writer has goal/scope/acceptance/handoff plus disjoint write_scope, accepted depends_on inputs, and declared produces. A first_checkpoint is optional when intermediate inspection is materially safer. This schema re-declares the base fields because allOf plus additionalProperties:false is unsatisfiable in Draft-07.

scope.description: Bounded responsibility of this branch; what it may touch and what it must not.

acceptance.description: Mechanically checkable conditions the parent verifies after the handoff.

status.description: Execution outcome. Never a quality verdict.

summary.description: Concise outcome. Raw tool output stays in artifacts.

evidence.description: Stable references (paths, commit, hashes) rather than copied raw output.

changes.description: Files or artifacts produced/modified by this branch.

gaps.description: Uncovered scope or known unknowns returned to the parent.

write_scope.description: Files/directories this writer may modify. One owner per file; barrels and shared contracts stay with the parent.

forbidden_scope.description: Explicitly out-of-bounds paths, including every other writer's write_scope.

depends_on.description: Accepted input contracts/artifacts that must be frozen before this writer starts.

produces.description: Outputs this writer declares and the parent's integration step consumes.

first_checkpoint.description: Optional failing test or minimum diff at which a high-risk or ownership-sensitive writer stops for parent inspection.
